Name: Monster Energy
Author: mjc76
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Adds a new 'Monster Energy Fruit' crop to the game as well as a purchasable recipe to cook 'Monster Energy', granting +2 Speed, +13 Energy and +5 Health as well as 3 new flavours.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Run the game using SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]New Crop - Monster Energy Fruit[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]New Seeds - Monster Energy Seeds[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]New Cooking Item - Monster Energy Original[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.5.2[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher v2.9.1[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Changelog[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=3]v1.2 - added Monster Ultra Black, Monster Pacific Punch and Monster Assault (Recipes from the Dwarf, Willy and Marlon respectively)[/size][/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]v1.1 - added Monster Energy Zero, Monster Mule and Monster Ultra White. (Recipes from Gus, Island Trader and Mr Qi respectively).[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]v1.0 - added Monster Energy Seeds, (Recipe obtainable from Friendship with Abigail and Sebastian), Monster Energy Fruit and Monster Energy Original (Recipe purchasable from Pierre).[/size][/color]
